intuition: The kth-largest value is the minimum among the largest k values.

brute_force.approach: Sort the array and read the value k positions from the end.
brute_force.space: O(1) or O(n), depending on the sort

optimal.approach: Maintain a size-k min-heap while scanning the array; a heap gives O(n log k) worst-case time. Quickselect is O(n) on average but O(n^2) in the worst case.

edge_cases: k may equal the array length, making the answer the minimum.
Duplicate values count as separate elements.
